description: The trader sold me a gas cooker with a cracked burner and will not take it back.
A cleaning business took payment for a full house clean but left without doing the agreed rooms.
My grocery order was cancelled by the seller after I paid. I am still waiting for the payment to be returned.
The dealer supplied a freezer that had been used before although the receipt says it was brand new.
A garage billed me for replacing the battery but another garage found that the old battery was still there.
I booked a parcel delivery and paid the fee. The courier lost the parcel and has ignored my complaint.
The online advert showed a leather handbag. The seller delivered a plastic bag and refuses an exchange.
The shop scanned the same packet twice and has declined to reverse the extra charge.
A technician took payment to install a water heater and disappeared before completing the installation.
The holiday lodge charged for a booking that it had already cancelled and is not answering my refund request.
I lent a workmate cash for an emergency. The agreed repayment day passed and he now avoids my calls.
The loan company has added a missed-payment charge even though I paid the instalment on time.
I borrowed from our savings group and want to dispute the remaining balance on that loan.
A collector says I must pay a relative's debt because I signed as their guarantor.
My mobile lender is collecting a loan that I have already finished repaying.
A neighbour acknowledged borrowing from me in a message but now says he will not return the money.
I paid the agreed settlement to the creditor and they are demanding the same debt again.
The SACCO has not recorded my repayment and is treating my loan as overdue.
I have fallen behind on a personal loan and need to discuss a repayment arrangement with the lender.
The borrowing agreement says one interest rate but the lender has calculated the debt using a higher one.
Our landlord removed the front door of our rented room while we were away.
My supervisor dismissed me after I complained about safety equipment at the workshop.
My sister and I disagree over who should administer our late father's estate.
A neighbour has placed a fence through our shared footpath and refuses to remove it.
The school excluded my child after a disciplinary meeting and has not explained its decision.
The name on my birth registration is misspelled and I need information about correcting the official record.
My former partner will not follow the arrangement for collecting our child after school.
The county office refused my building permit application and I want to understand the appeal process.
My employer moved me to a night shift after I reported harassment by a colleague.
My landlord has threatened to evict us despite the tenancy agreement still being in force.
I need some help please.
Something happened and I do not know what to do.
There is a problem between us.
I have a question about an issue.
Can someone point me in the right direction?
Things are not okay at the moment.
